City of Inglewood

  MINUTES
  CLAIMS REVIEW COMMITTEE
  April 08, 2019

A meeting of the Claims Review Committee was held in the Small Executive Conference
Room, 9th floor at 11:35 a.m.

  Members Present: Debbie Crenshaw, Deputy City Treasurer
  Yvonne Horton, City Clerk
  Maria E. Heaney, Revenue Manager

  Staff Present:  Markland Watson, Public Works Supervisor

1. The minutes of April 02, 2019, meeting was approved as recorded.

2. J & J Muffler - A motion was moved and seconded to approve the recommended
  settlement payment of $4,613.08. Motion carried unanimously.

3. There being no further business, the meeting adjourned at 11:45 a.m.

Adjournment
